exposure: genetic variants (SNPs in MC4R, TMEM18, KCTD15, SH2B1, SEC16B, BDNF, NEGR1, OLFM4, HOXB5 genes)
cohort: 745 South Brazilian children from two cohorts, followed up since birth.
finding: Genetic variants in/near MC4R, TMEM18, KCTD15, SH2B1, SEC16B, BDNF, NEGR1, OLFM4, and HOXB5 genes contribute to obesity susceptibility in childhood and affect obesity-related phenotypes at specific ages.
